messages:
maria: Heads up — keystore safelist rollout to eu-west just went live and we're seeing GPU nodes failing to join the pool. Errors look like KMS decrypt timeout + 403 from privatelink. :warning:
ajay: Can you paste the logs?
maria: Pasting minimal tail from node bootstrap (redacted) — seen on 3 different nodes:
```
[2026-03-21T14:22:03Z] keystore-proxy: request to /decrypt timed out (deadline exceeded)
[2026-03-21T14:22:03Z] keystore-client: received HTTP 403 from privatelink endpoint
[2026-03-21T14:22:04Z] node-join: failed k/v cache init, retrying
```
sam: That pattern looks like the privatelink is getting allowed but the warm-pool NAT range wasn't included in the safelist. Keystore proxy sees calls from unexpected source and rejects -> 403.
dana: Who pushed the safelist change? I thought we had a canary in staging.
maria: @leo did the rollout earlier, canary looked fine in staging but staging uses different NAT ranges. Looks like the rollout checklist missed verifying egress CIDRs.
leo: yep that's on me — staging vs eu-west NAT range mismatch. I'm prepping a quick firewall patch to add the missing cidrs.
ops-bot: infra-deploy: PR #789 (firewall: allow 10.4.55.0/24, 10.4.56.0/24) opened by leo — awaiting review.
ajay: If we patch firewall, do we need to restart failed nodes? Will joins auto-retry?
maria: joins will auto-retry but we should avoid mass restarts; nodes will eventually reattempt and warm pool will refill. Concern: cost spike from rewarming. We're already seeing about +1.2 GPU-hours attributed to retries.
sam: Alternative is rollback safelist. But rollback means traffic will go through fallback keystore path which is slower and may increase latency for production inference.
dana: Also note rollback won't help if the NAT range is required by the keystore to validate request source — we might still need the CIDR open. And audit logging requires us to record changes.
leo: I'm adding the CIDR to firewall now and will annotate the change with links to the rollout ticket. ETA ~8m.
ops-bot: infra-deploy: PR #789 merged by leo — firewall rules applied.
leo: Applied and pushed. Can someone confirm node join behaviour?
ops-bot: node-monitor: previously 3/6 stalled -> 6/6 joined within 3 minutes after fw change.
maria: Nice. Action items: 1) revert the safelist rollout temporarily (so we don't accidentally block other regions while we audit CIDRs), 2) update rollout checklist to include NAT/privatelink CIDR verification, 3) add alert for keystore HTTP 403 rate per region, 4) postmortem.
sam: I'll own the postmortem and runbook updates. Will include timeline and cost estimate.
ajay: Cost note: ~1.2 GPU-hours -> approx $28 additional this window. Put that in postmortem.
dana: Also add a note for compliance: we touched firewall/egress rules — remember to include auditlog export link and change-ticket ID to the postmortem.
maria: Agreed. For next rollout: require canary to run in same subnet/NAT config as prod or use IP-level stubbing.
leo: Will open a follow-up PR to add the extra verification to the CI gating the rollout.
ops-bot: paging: oncall notified (tag: @oncall).
maria: Thanks everyone — closing once postmortem link is posted.
